title: Paid time off request window
content: Employees request paid time off at least ten business days before the first day of leave, except for illness or emergency absences. Managers respond within three business days. Unused PTO may carry over up to five days into the next calendar year.

title: Connecting to office Wi-Fi
content: Join the Guest-Corp network, open any browser page, and complete the captive portal with your work email. For the secure Staff network, use your device management profile; contact IT if the profile is missing. Guest access expires after eight hours.

title: Nightly database backup verification
content: After 02:00 UTC, confirm the overnight backup job completed with status success. Spot-check that the latest dump size is within ten percent of the prior night. If the job failed, page the on-call engineer and do not start schema migrations until a good backup exists.
